title: Parcels 4, 5, 13, 14 and 15
previewText: On Parcels 4, 5, 13, 14 and 15, where a shore public walkway is required, such shore public walkway shall have a minimum width of 30 feet. The required minimum depth of a waterfront yard shall be 30 feet.
